content:
maya: Quick sync — onboarding weights for redwood-mono-7b. HF path: https://huggingface.co/redwood/redwood-mono-7b. Plan: mirror to s3://rwd-artifacts/models/redwood-mono-7b/v1/. Who can kick off mirror + checksum?

kevin: I can take it. Need the exact file list (pytorch_model shards, config.json, tokenizer files). Also confirm if HF used LFS pointers.

jordan: Tokenizer quirk to watch: tokenizer.json on HF is missing pad_token. Training used '<|pad|>' as pad_token and tokenizer_class was 'PreTrainedTokenizerFast'. If we don't patch, serving will pad with 0 -> misaligned logits.

maya: Good catch. Jordan, can you push a tiny patch that adds pad_token, or share the jq command and I’ll run it before mirroring?

jordan: Patch command I used locally:
```
jq '.model_max_length=4096 | .pad_token="<|pad|>"' tokenizer.json > tokenizer_patched.json && aws s3 cp tokenizer_patched.json s3://rwd-artifacts/models/redwood-mono-7b/v1/tokenizer.json
```
Run that before validation.

kevin: Started mirror job:
```
mirrorer start --src hf://redwood/redwood-mono-7b --dst s3://rwd-artifacts/models/redwood-mono-7b/v1 --include 'pytorch_*' 'tokenizer*' 'config.json' --verify-checksum
```
job id: mirror-2024-06-12-01

infra-bot: mirrorer job mirror-2024-06-12-01 queued on infra-cluster-5. ETA ~15m.

samuel: For config validation, run:
```
rwd-tools model-validate --weights s3://rwd-artifacts/models/redwood-mono-7b/v1 --config s3://rwd-artifacts/models/redwood-mono-7b/v1/config.json
```
Important: ensure kv_cache_layers matches the runtime (12 or 24 depending on compiled kernels).

kevin: Checksum summary (shortened): md5=3a7b9d8f1a2b3c4d, sha256=e4f1c2b8d9e0f7a6... I pushed manifest.json to s3://rwd-artifacts/models/redwood-mono-7b/v1/manifest.json containing file list + checksums + HF commit.

maya: @kevin awesome. Can you make sure HF commit sha is in the manifest so we can trace it back?

kevin: Added HF commit sha: a1b2c3d4ef to manifest and set "mirrored": true. Also included file sizes.

infra-bot: mirrorer job mirror-2024-06-12-01 succeeded (15m). Checksums verified. Registered artifact id: rwd:models:redwood-mono-7b:v1.

jordan: I opened a PR to model-config that sets tokenizer_class and pad_token in registry metadata; PR#412. Please review when you get a chance @maya @samuel :eyes:

maya: Reviewing now. After registry update, can we schedule a warmup on Dedicated (one GPU) for canary traffic? Need to validate latency under warm cache.

samuel: On Dedicated side I’ll add route tag 'canary-redwood-mono-7b' and pre-allocate 1 GPU for warmup. Autoscale min=1 max=4. Will post the plan in the deployment ticket.

kevin: One more note: HF had 2 LFS shards named 'pytorch_model-00001-of-00002.bin' etc. mirrorer resolved them but double-check file-size in manifest matches the actual shard size. I flagged in manifest if mismatch.

maya: Great. Closing thread for now — will follow PR + registry entry. Thanks everyone :tada:
